subject: Biology
title: Neural Control and Coordination
summary: Nervous system neuron se bana hai jo electrical impulses le jaate hain. Human system mein central nervous system (brain aur spinal cord) aur peripheral nervous system (cranial aur spinal nerves; somatic aur autonomic) hain.

Resting neuron polarised hota hai (bahar positive, andar negative, lagbhag −70 mV — resting potential) Na⁺/K⁺ pump ki wajah se. Stimulus Na⁺ channels kholta hai (depolarisation), aur action potential axon par aage badhta hai.
Impulse agle cell tak synapse se jaata hai — electrical (tez) ya chemical (acetylcholine jaise neurotransmitters).

Brain mein forebrain (cerebrum, thalamus, hypothalamus), midbrain aur hindbrain (pons, cerebellum, medulla); medulla aur pons brain stem ka hissa hain. Reflex, retina aur cochlea bhi isi chapter mein.

formulas.name: Neuron parts
formulas.formula: cell body (cyton, with Nissl's granules) + dendrites (carry impulses towards cell body) + axon (carries impulses away, ends in synaptic knobs)

formulas.name: Myelinated vs non-myelinated
formulas.formula: myelinated: Schwann cells form myelin sheath, nodes of Ranvier — spinal and cranial nerves (saltatory, faster conduction);  non-myelinated: autonomous and somatic neural systems

formulas.name: Resting potential
formulas.formula: inside −ve, outside +ve;  high K⁺ and negative proteins inside, high Na⁺ outside;  Na⁺/K⁺ pump: 3 Na⁺ out, 2 K⁺ in per ATP

formulas.name: Action potential
formulas.formula: stimulus → Na⁺ channels open → Na⁺ rushes in → depolarisation (inside +ve);  then K⁺ channels open → K⁺ moves out → repolarisation

formulas.name: Synapse types
formulas.formula: electrical (gap junctions, very fast, rare);  chemical (synaptic cleft; neurotransmitter like acetylcholine released from vesicles binds receptors on post-synaptic membrane)

formulas.name: Forebrain
formulas.formula: cerebrum (two hemispheres joined by corpus callosum; cortex = grey matter, sensory, motor and association areas);  thalamus (relay centre);  hypothalamus (body temperature, hunger, thirst, neurosecretory cells → hormones)

formulas.name: Limbic system
formulas.formula: amygdala + hippocampus + inner parts of cerebral hemispheres + hypothalamus → sexual behaviour, emotional reactions (excitement, pleasure, rage, fear) and motivation

formulas.name: Midbrain
formulas.formula: corpora quadrigemina (four lobes) — visual and auditory reflexes; cerebral aqueduct passes through

formulas.name: Hindbrain
formulas.formula: pons (connects brain regions, respiratory centre);  cerebellum (balance, posture, coordination; 'little brain' with many folds);  medulla oblongata (respiration, cardiovascular reflexes, gastric secretions)
formulas.mistake: Brain stem = midbrain + pons + medulla oblongata (cerebellum isme nahi).

formulas.name: Reflex arc
formulas.formula: receptor → afferent (sensory) neuron → spinal cord (inter-neuron) → efferent (motor) neuron → effector

formulas.name: Eye layers
formulas.formula: sclera (outer, cornea in front) → choroid (middle, iris, ciliary body) → retina (inner: ganglion cells, bipolar cells, photoreceptors — rods and cones)

formulas.name: Photoreceptors
formulas.formula: rods: rhodopsin (visual purple), dim light (scotopic) vision;  cones: photopsins, bright light (photopic) and colour vision (red, green, blue)
formulas.mistake: Fovea mein sirf cones (sabse saaf vision); blind spot mein koi photoreceptor nahi — ulta mat likhna.

formulas.name: Ear parts and functions
formulas.formula: outer: pinna, auditory canal, tympanic membrane;  middle: malleus, incus, stapes (ossicles), Eustachian tube;  inner: cochlea (hearing — organ of Corti on basilar membrane), vestibular apparatus (balance — crista in ampullae, macula in saccule and utricle)

examples.title: Sensory ya motor?
examples.problem: Kaunse neurons spinal cord se muscles tak impulse le jaate hain?
examples.solution: Efferent (motor) neurons. Afferent (sensory) neurons receptors se CNS tak impulse le jaate hain.

examples.title: Depolarisation
examples.problem: Action potential ka rising phase kis ion ki movement se hota hai?
examples.solution: Voltage-gated sodium channels se Na⁺ ka tezi se andar aana polarity ulat deta hai (andar positive ho jaata hai).

examples.title: Hypothalamus ka kaam
examples.problem: Hypothalamus ke control wale teen kaam batao.
examples.solution: Body temperature, bhookh aur pyaas (khaane-peene ki ichchha); isme neurosecretory cells bhi hain jo hypothalamic hormones banate hain.

examples.title: Blind spot
examples.problem: Blind spot par padne wali image kyun nahi dikhti?
examples.solution: Blind spot par optic nerve aankh se nikalti hai aur retinal blood vessels andar aati hain; wahan photoreceptor cells nahi hote.

examples.title: Saltatory conduction
examples.problem: Myelinated fibres mein conduction tez kyun hota hai?
examples.solution: Myelin axon ko insulate karta hai; impulse ek node of Ranvier se agle par koodta hai (saltatory conduction).

examples.title: Hearing mechanism
examples.problem: Sound ka brain tak raasta batao.
examples.solution: Pinna → ear canal → tympanic membrane kaanpti hai → ossicles (malleus, incus, stapes) → oval window → cochlear lymph mein waves → basilar membrane hilti hai → organ of Corti ke hair cells mudte hain → auditory nerve se nerve impulses → auditory cortex.

topics.title: Neural system in animals
topics.explain: Neeche ke invertebrates mein neurons ka simple network (Hydra — nerve net). Insects mein brain aur kai ganglia. Vertebrates mein zyada developed system.

topics.title: Autonomic nervous system
topics.explain: PNS ka hissa jo involuntary organs aur smooth muscles control karta hai; sympathetic aur parasympathetic systems mein bata, jinka asar aam taur par ulta hota hai.

topics.title: Human brain coverings
topics.explain: Brain skull aur teen meninges se surakshit: bahar dura mater, beech mein patli arachnoid aur andar pia mater (brain tissue se chipki). Cerebrospinal fluid gaddi ka kaam karta hai.

topics.title: Cerebral cortex
topics.explain: Bahar grey matter (cell bodies) convolutions ke saath; andar white matter (myelinated tracts). Association areas complex kaam sambhaalte hain jaise intersensory associations, memory aur communication.

topics.title: Image formation
topics.explain: Light cornea aur lens se guzarkar retina par image banati hai. Light rhodopsin mein retinal (vitamin A derivative) ko badalti hai, photoreceptors mein potentials bante hain jo bipolar aur ganglion cells se optic nerve aur visual cortex tak jaate hain.

topics.title: Sensory organs other than eye and ear
topics.explain: Naak mein olfactory receptors (olfactory epithelium limbic system se juda); jeebh par taste buds; skin mein touch, pressure, pain aur temperature receptors.

ratta: Resting potential: inside −ve; Na⁺/K⁺ pump 3 out, 2 in.
Depolarisation = Na⁺ in;  repolarisation = K⁺ out.
Multipolar cortex;  bipolar retina;  unipolar embryo.
Thalamus relay;  hypothalamus temperature, hunger, thirst.
Cerebellum balance;  medulla breathing & heart reflexes.
